The '''Ma'alin Farmstead''' was a [[windfarm]], part of the [[Breezefield Farms]] complex located in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was overrun by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:BF" />
